headline: Margins to remain better than industry

highlights: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Star Cement (STACEM) CMP: ₹175 Target ₹ 215 (+23%) Target Period: 12 months November 13, 2026 Margins to remain better than industry … About the stock : Star Cement is a leading cement manufacturer in India with a strong foothold in North-Eastern region and a rapidly expanding presence in Eastern region states also (like West Bengal and Bihar).
It has market share of ~27% in North-East markets Q 2F Y2 7 performance : Revenue increased by 2.5% YoY (-11.9% QoQ) to Rs 831 crores, led by volume growth of 2.3% YoY (-11.6% QoQ) to 1.20 mtpa.
EBITDA/ton declined by 21.2% YoY (-10.8% QoQ) to Rs 1281/ton.

Reported PAT of Rs 39.6 crore (-44.3% YoY, -46.5% QoQ) Investment Rationale : • Volume growth expected to pick - up from H2FY27 ; ~9% CAGR over FY26 - 28E : Company reported muted volume growth of 2.5% YoY in Q2FY27, mainly on account of floods in Assam (majority market for the company) and elections in north-east.

Rating and Target Price : • We have trimmed our EBITDA estimates for FY27E/28E factoring in relatively muted H1FY27 and elevated input costs.

While management indicated that the price increase outside Northeast remains relatively weak, it expects the ~₹10/bag increase in Northeast to sustain. • Management reiterated its EBITDA guidance and expected to achieve the previously communicated target of ₹1,500–1,600/ton by the end of FY27, despite the relatively weak performance in H1FY27. • Fuel cost stood at ₹1.52/1,000 kcal during Q2FY27.
watch: EBITDA/ton stood at Rs 1364/ton (vs Rs 1397/ton for H1FY26) Recent earnings call highlights • Management attributed the subdued H1FY27 performance to elections and floods in Assam, particularly affecting demand in its key Northeast market.
